pages.title: R-Process Cluster
pages.text: Gold, platinum and uranium, made in seconds when a supernova or neutron star merger floods nuclei with neutrons faster than they can decay. The cluster is a dense jumble of heavy metal nuggets, gleaming in several colours at once.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Firing neutrino flux and a sterile neutrino at a supernova remnant in the Nucleosynthesis Chamber, I saw nuclei capturing neutrons faster than they could decay. Heavy elements formed in a single flash.
